fullDescription: Loud neo-brutalist FAQ landing page on warm paper with one acid-yellow accent: a sticky 3px-bordered nav, a graph-paper hero ('Questions, answered loudly.' with an acid underline highlight), a scrolling ink marquee, and a stack of hard-offset-shadow accordion cards (one pre-opened with an acid bar + a plus-to-minus toggle), closed by a black 'Still stuck?' CTA card and an acid pricing band.

structured.summary: A loud neo-brutalist FAQ landing page. A sticky paper nav with a heavy 3px ink border sits over a full-bleed graph-paper hero ('Questions, answered loudly.' with an acid-yellow underline highlight on the last word) and a scrolling ink marquee strip of product proof points. The FAQ itself is a stack of thick-bordered cards, each carrying a hard 6px offset drop-shadow; one row ships pre-opened with an acid-yellow summary bar and a minus toggle while closed rows show a paper bar and an acid-yellow plus box. A black 'Still stuck on something?' CTA card with an acid offset shadow and a full-bleed acid pricing teaser band close the page above a paper footer.

style.description: Aggressive neo-brutalist / Swiss-poster aesthetic. The whole page sits on a warm paper #f4f1ea base; near-black ink #0a0a0a carries every border (a consistent 3px stroke), all text, and the inverted marquee / CTA / footer-mark fills; a single high-voltage acid #e8ff00 yellow is the only accent and it does the loud work: the hero word highlight, summary bars on the open row, plus/minus toggle boxes, button fills, the marquee proof chips and the full-bleed pricing band. The brutalist signature is the HARD OFFSET SHADOW, a solid (non-blurred) 6px 6px 0 ink shadow on cards (4px on small chips, 10px on the open row, and a 6px acid shadow on the black CTA card), never a soft blur. A faint ink graph-paper grid (38px cells at 6% opacity) backs the hero, echoing engineering paper. Type is all-caps and brutal: Archivo (a grotesk, used at weight 800/900 for headlines, nav and buttons) paired with Space Mono (monospace, used for eyebrows, body copy and the marquee), with tight tracking on display type and wide tracking on the mono eyebrows. Interactions are physical: buttons translate up/left on hover and snap back on active, the marquee scrolls infinitely, and the CSS-only accordion expands via a grid-template-rows 0fr->1fr transition.
style.prompt: Design a loud neo-brutalist / Swiss-poster aesthetic. Background warm paper #f4f1ea; one near-black ink #0a0a0a used for ALL borders (a consistent 3px solid stroke), text, and inverted fills (marquee bar, CTA card, footer mark); exactly one accent, a high-voltage acid yellow #e8ff00, used sparingly but loudly (the hero word highlight, open-row summary bars, plus/minus toggle boxes, primary button fills, marquee chips, the full-bleed pricing band). The signature device is a HARD OFFSET SHADOW: box-shadow 6px 6px 0 0 #0a0a0a on cards (variants: 4px small, 10px on the open/active row, and 6px 6px 0 #e8ff00 acid on the black CTA card), always solid with zero blur, never a soft shadow. Back the hero with a faint graph-paper grid: two repeating linear-gradients of rgba(10,10,10,0.06) 1px lines at 38px x 38px. Set headlines, nav and buttons in Archivo (grotesk) at weight 800/900, UPPERCASE, tight tracking; set eyebrows, body copy and the marquee in Space Mono (monospace), with eyebrows uppercase at wide ~0.1-0.2em tracking. Make interactions physical: hover translates buttons up/left by ~2px and active snaps them back; an infinite CSS marquee; selection swaps to acid bg / ink text. Hero headline uses an acid 'underline highlight' (a linear-gradient(#e8ff00,#e8ff00) no-repeat at 0 88% / 100% 38%) under one word. No rounded corners; everything is square and hard-edged.

layout_and_structure.description: A sticky paper nav with a 3px ink bottom border, then a full-bleed graph-paper hero, an ink marquee strip, the FAQ section (an intro split-header + a stack of hard-shadow accordion cards + a black CTA card), a full-bleed acid pricing teaser band, and a paper footer. The page is centered in a max-w-[1180px] container with px-5 / sm:px-8 gutters, divided by full-bleed 3px ink section borders.

prompts.prompt: A sticky top-0 z-50 header, paper #f4f1ea fill, with a 3px ink #0a0a0a bottom border. Inside, a max-w-[1180px] mx-auto flex row, px-5 sm:px-8 py-3, items centered, space-between. Left: a brand lockup = a 36px square with a 3px ink border and an acid #e8ff00 fill carrying a 4px ink hard offset shadow, holding a ph:asterisk-bold icon, next to a 19px Archivo weight-900 UPPERCASE 'PROMPTYARD' wordmark with tight tracking. Center (hidden below md): nav links 'LIBRARY / FAQ / PRICING' in 14px Archivo weight-700 uppercase, wide tracking, each with an acid underline-highlight on hover. Right: a primary 'START FREE' link = ink #0a0a0a fill, 3px ink border, paper text, 13px Archivo weight-800 uppercase, with a 4px ink hard offset shadow that translates up on hover and snaps back on active; plus a square 36px paper hamburger button (3px border, 4px hard shadow, ph:list-bold) visible only below md.

A full-bleed section with the graph-paper grid backdrop (rgba(10,10,10,0.06) 1px lines at 38px cells) and a 3px ink bottom border. Inside a max-w-[1180px] px-5 sm:px-8 py-16 sm:py-24 block: an inline eyebrow pill = acid #e8ff00 fill, 3px ink border, 4px hard offset shadow, holding a ph:question-bold icon + a Space Mono 12px weight-700 uppercase wide-tracked 'SUPPORT / FAQ'. Then an oversized Archivo weight-900 UPPERCASE h1 at clamp(2.6rem,8vw,5.6rem), leading 0.92, tight tracking, reading 'Questions, / answered loudly.' on two lines with the word 'loudly' wrapped in the acid underline-highlight. Below, a Space Mono ~15-16px ink/80 lead paragraph (max-w-[52ch]) in the warm proactive-friend voice. Then a button row: a primary acid 'Read the FAQ' button (3px ink border, acid fill, 6px ink hard offset shadow, ph:arrow-down-bold icon) and a secondary paper 'Browse the library' button (3px ink border, paper fill, 6px ink hard offset shadow), both Archivo 14px weight-800 uppercase, translating up/left ~2px on hover and snapping back on active.

Directly under the hero, a full-bleed ink #0a0a0a bar with a 3px ink bottom border and py-2.5, overflow-hidden. Inside, a w-max flex row that animates infinitely (translateX 0 -> -50% over ~22s linear) by duplicating the chip set twice. Each chip is a Space Mono 13px weight-700 UPPERCASE wide-tracked proof point prefixed by an acid asterisk, alternating acid #e8ff00 and paper text on the black bar: 'Credits never expire', 'Infinite canvas', '2,400+ prompts', 'Works in Claude Code & Cursor', 'Cancel anytime'.

prompts.prompt: Inside the FAQ section (max-w-[1180px], px-5 sm:px-8, py-16 sm:py-24, 3px ink bottom border), a split header grid (md:grid-cols-[1fr_auto], items-end, gap-6, mb-12): on the left a Space Mono 12px weight-700 uppercase wide-tracked ink/60 eyebrow '[ Frequently asked ]' above an Archivo weight-900 UPPERCASE h2 'The honest FAQ' at clamp(2rem,5vw,3.4rem) leading 0.95; on the right a Space Mono 14px ink/70 helper line (max-w-[34ch], md:text-right) 'Tap a question to open it. Real answers, written by humans who use the thing.'

Each FAQ entry is a native <details> card: block, 3px ink #0a0a0a border, paper #f4f1ea fill, a 6px 6px 0 ink hard offset shadow, stacked with space-y-5. The summary (list-marker hidden) is a flex items-center justify-between row, bg paper, px-5 py-4 sm:px-7 sm:py-5: an Archivo weight-800 UPPERCASE question (17px / sm:20px, tight tracking) on the left, and on the right a 32px square toggle box with a 3px ink border and an ACID #e8ff00 fill holding a plus glyph built from two absolutely-positioned ink bars (a 3px-tall horizontal bar + a 3px-wide vertical bar). The answer panel is collapsed via a CSS grid-template-rows 0fr -> 1fr transition (~320ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1)) so it is fully hidden when closed.

Ship the FIRST row ('What exactly is Promptyard?') pre-opened. When open: the summary bar fills ACID #e8ff00 (the question stays ink), the card's hard offset shadow grows to 10px 10px 0 ink (it lifts), the toggle box flips to a PAPER fill, and the vertical bar of the plus rotates 90deg + fades to opacity 0 (becoming a minus). The answer panel expands (grid-rows 1fr) revealing a Space Mono 14px sm:15px ink/85 paragraph separated from the summary by a 3px ink top border, px-5 py-5 sm:px-7 sm:py-6. Optional JS keeps the accordion single-open (opening one closes the others) but the layout works with pure CSS and no JS.

prompts.prompt: Below the accordion, a 'Still stuck on something?' CTA card: ink #0a0a0a fill, 3px ink border, a 6px 6px 0 ACID #e8ff00 hard offset shadow, p-7 sm:p-9, flex column on mobile / row on sm. Left: an Archivo weight-900 UPPERCASE paper heading at clamp(1.4rem,3vw,2rem) + a Space Mono 14px paper/70 sub-line in the warm friend voice ('Ping us and we'll sort it together. Real reply from a real person, usually same day.'). Right: a solid acid 'Talk to us' button (acid fill + 3px acid border, ink text, Archivo 14px weight-800 uppercase, ph:arrow-up-right-bold). Then a full-bleed acid #e8ff00 pricing teaser band (3px ink bottom border, py-14 sm:py-16) with an Archivo weight-900 UPPERCASE h2 'Ready to design out loud?' (clamp(1.6rem,4vw,2.8rem)) beside a paper 'Start free' button with a 6px ink hard offset shadow and a ph:arrow-right-bold icon. Finally a paper footer (max-w-[1180px], flex, py-8): a small 28px acid square asterisk mark + a Space Mono 12px uppercase 'Promptyard (c) 2026' on the left, and Space Mono 12px uppercase 'Twitter / GitHub / Status' links (acid underline-highlight on hover) on the right.

special_ui_components.prompt: Hard offset shadow system: solid (zero-blur) box-shadow 6px 6px 0 ink on cards, with 4px (chips), 10px (open/active row) and 6px acid (#e8ff00, on the black CTA card) variants
Graph-paper hero backdrop: two repeating rgba(10,10,10,0.06) 1px linear-gradients at 38px x 38px cells
Acid underline-highlight: a linear-gradient(#e8ff00,#e8ff00) no-repeat painted at background-position 0 88% / size 100% 38% under a single hero word and on nav/footer link hover
CSS-only <details> accordion expanding via grid-template-rows 0fr -> 1fr (~320ms cubic-bezier), with optional JS for single-open behavior

Built-from-bars plus/minus toggle: a 32px bordered acid box with two absolutely-positioned ink bars; on open the vertical bar rotates 90deg + fades, the box flips to paper, and the summary bar fills acid
Infinite ink marquee strip of acid-asterisk proof chips (translateX 0 -> -50% over 22s, duplicated set), plus physical hover/active button translation (up/left ~2px, snap back)

structured.special_notes: Centered max-w-[1180px] container with px-5 / sm:px-8 gutters throughout, sections divided by full-bleed 3px ink bottom borders. Palette is fixed and minimal: paper #f4f1ea base, ink #0a0a0a for ALL borders (3px) + text + inverted fills, and exactly one acid #e8ff00 accent. Fonts are Archivo (grotesk, weights 400-900, uppercase display/nav/buttons) + Space Mono (monospace, eyebrows/body/marquee), via Google Fonts; icons are Phosphor (ph:*) via Iconify. Exactly one accordion row ships pre-opened. Every shadow is a HARD solid offset (no blur), and nothing is rounded. Responsive: the nav center links collapse to a hamburger below md, the hero/headlines scale via clamp, the FAQ split-header and the CTA card stack to a single column on small screens, and there is no horizontal overflow at 390px. Copy is human and reassuring with zero em-dashes (warm proactive-friend voice: 'No fluff, no support bot', 'ping us and we'll sort it together', 'Real reply from a real person, usually same day').
